entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I will be honest with you. I'm con..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will be honest with you. I'm considering reforming the Rizian government."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""No, that will be all.""
entries.dialogueText: "No, that will be all."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Your Grace, I feel the situation a..."
entries.dialogueText: "Your Grace, I feel the situation as you've just described it leaves me with limited power over my own kingdom. I wish to reign unchallenged by the House of Delegates or any of the noble families."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's eyes widened in shock. Hugo..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's eyes widened in shock. Hugo appeared unfazed.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Surprise registered on Hugo's face,..."
entries.dialogueText: Surprise registered on Hugo's face, but only for a second. He stroked his chin.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""You've hit upon an interesting poi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You've hit upon an interesting point, Romus."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina opened her mouth in shock."
entries.dialogueText: Vina opened her mouth in shock.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Surprise flashed across Hugo's face..."
entries.dialogueText: Surprise flashed across Hugo's face, but only for a second.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I hope you don't have any drastic..."
entries.dialogueText: "I hope you don't have any drastic changes in mind, Romus."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The RPP may try to claim otherwise..."
entries.dialogueText: "The RPP may try to claim otherwise, but the citizens of Rizia hardly hunger for reform. The majority are perfectly satisfied with things as they are."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""This wouldn't be for me. I want to..."
entries.dialogueText: "This wouldn't be for me. I want to pave the way for Vina and all of her descendents."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""How do you know support is high? A..."
entries.dialogueText: "How do you know support is high? Anyone could be plotting anything at any time. It unsettles me."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""You're right. I'm better off keepi..."
entries.dialogueText: "You're right. I'm better off keeping things as they are."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I myself have often wondered wheth..."
entries.dialogueText: "I myself have often wondered whether Rizia would be stronger were it wholly united under the banner of House Toras."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Ultimately, though, the Crown enjo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Ultimately, though, the Crown enjoys high support among both the Delegates and the noble houses. I fear any attempt to defang them will lead to more strife than it is worth."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""Do you know that for sure, Uncle H..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you know that for sure, Uncle Hugo? Our only information source is the Royal Herald, after all."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina's nose wrinkled."
entries.dialogueText: Vina's nose wrinkled.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""What's more, the nobility would ne..."
entries.dialogueText: "What's more, the nobility would never tolerate such a major shake-up. Why, it was all Valero could do to get them to accept the House of Delegates."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have my ear to the ground. Any p..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have my ear to the ground. Any potential sources of discontent are the ones I've already mentioned. Hardly worth rearranging the government for."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Let's just forget I asked this que..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's just forget I asked this question."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A major shake-up is not what I had..."
entries.dialogueText: "A major shake-up is not what I had in mind. I only want a few small tweaks here and there."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo firmly pressed his hands on th..."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo firmly pressed his hands on the table.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""Thank you for your opinion. I'll k..."
entries.dialogueText: "Thank you for your opinion. I'll keep it in mind."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo looked unsatisfied."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo looked unsatisfied.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Please do.""
entries.dialogueText: "Please do."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""A more democratic Rizia would bene..."
entries.dialogueText: "A more democratic Rizia would benefit all of us. Citizens and nobles alike."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""As king, you can directly make Riz..."
entries.dialogueText: "As king, you can directly make Rizians' lives better with the stroke of a pen. I don't see why anyone would trade that for populism and infighting."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""The best advice I can give you is..."
entries.dialogueText: "The best advice I can give you is to proceed gradually. Else you risk hurting the very citizens you wish to help."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo looked unsatisfied."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo looked unsatisfied.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Very well.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very well."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Vina looked askance at me, but said..."
entries.dialogueText: Vina looked askance at me, but said nothing.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I have my ear to the ground. The o..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have my ear to the ground. The only potential sources of discontent are the ones I already mentioned. For now."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Very good.""
entries.dialogueText: "Very good."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Hugo gave an approving nod."
entries.dialogueText: Hugo gave an approving nod.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I completely understand the impuls..."
entries.dialogueText: "I completely understand the impulse. But upset the balance of power too suddenly, and your path will be far from smooth."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""There is nothing stopping you from..."
entries.dialogueText: "There is nothing stopping you from passing laws aimed at centralization. But it must be done with the utmost of sensitivity."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "My uncle arched an eyebrow."
entries.dialogueText: My uncle arched an eyebrow.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""If it appears that any of the hous..."
entries.dialogueText: "If it appears that any of the houses are about to pose a threat -- well, then we can have this conversation again."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""But I fear that Rizia is straying..."
entries.dialogueText: "But I fear that Rizia is straying from its Wruhecist roots. Only I can restore religious harmony to the kingdom."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""The measures I intend to implement..."
entries.dialogueText: "The measures I intend to implement are necessary, but they won't be popular. I want to make sure they're met with minimal backlash."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""I see...""
entries.dialogueText: "I see..."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""In that case, I am sure the religi..."
entries.dialogueText: "In that case, I am sure the religious community will support you. But Grand Wiseman Ignacius can advise you better than I can on this matter."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""It is true that the nobles in this..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is true that the nobles in this kingdom often have trouble seeing past their own provinces."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Please trust that I will come to y..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please trust that I will come to you if the situation changes."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Unless any of the houses pose an i..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unless any of the houses pose an immediate threat, of course. In which case more drastic action would be justified."

entries.speaker: Player_Romus
entries.title: Player_Romus: ""I worry the modern era may bring u..."
entries.dialogueText: "I worry the modern era may bring unwanted change to Rizia. All I've ever wanted was to keep things as they are."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I saw sympathy in Hugo's eyes."
entries.dialogueText: I saw sympathy in Hugo's eyes.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""That is perhaps the most challengi..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is perhaps the most challenging duty of a monarch -- to project stability and serenity even amidst the most violent of tempests."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""But you are not alone. Have faith..."
entries.dialogueText: "But you are not alone. Have faith in House Toras and the Rizian National Coalition to help you preserve calm and order."

entries.speaker: Princess Vina
entries.title: Vina Toras: ""There's also GRACE, right? As long..."
entries.dialogueText: "There's also GRACE, right? As long as we're a member, we can rely on Rumburg and the others to keep the monarchy strong."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Absolutely, Your Highness. Your au..."
entries.dialogueText: "Absolutely, Your Highness. Your aunt would never let anything get in the way of your future reign."

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""And do not forget that we are part..."
entries.dialogueText: "And do not forget that we are part of a network of monarchies. Rumburg and the other members of GRACE have a vested interest in ensuring a smooth reign for you and your descendents."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He took one last curious look at me..."
entries.dialogueText: He took one last curious look at me before brightening up.

entries.speaker: Hugo Toras
entries.title: Hugo Toras: ""Hmm. Such a strategy could pacify..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hmm. Such a strategy could pacify would-be reformists without ruffling the feathers of those who prefer the status quo."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He was pensive for a moment; then,..."
entries.dialogueText: He was pensive for a moment; then, his expression brightened.
